# ADR-0001: Recording traps

## Context

We keep a numbered catalogue of recurring pitfalls, and refer to entries in it
with wiki-link syntax so they stand out when reading.

## Decision

A brief that quotes a closed entry as if it were still open is exactly
[[trap 55]], and quoting a register body rather than its state is [[trap 54]].

## Consequences

The catalogue is a section of this document, not a document per trap.
